snippet_primary: "Envato Elements scores lower on photography ADI but significantly higher on template and motion graphics ADI. Additionally, Envato actively curates its design assets with community-based quality filtering. Their fonts library is one of the strongest available under any subscription, and their audio collection rivals dedicated music licensing platforms."
